name: gqr
summary: gqr generates and shows QR code in your terminal.
behavior: B1: Encode the message given with -m as a QR code and print it to stdout.
B2: When -m is not given, read all of stdin as the message and remove one trailing newline if present.

B3: Print one line per row of the QR code. Every module is two space characters painted with an ANSI background colour: ESC[47m (white) for a light module, ESC[40m (black) for a dark module. End each line with ESC[0m and a newline.
B4: Surround the code with a quiet zone of light modules; the border the library produces by default is right. Every line has the same number of modules and the output is square.
B5: Use the medium error-correction level.
B6: If the message is empty, print 'gqr: empty message' to stderr and exit 1.
